verdict.rationale: GitHub docs claim Hatchet provides 'automatic retries' as part of its platform, and a founder comment notes workflows are declared ahead of time rather than needing try/catch around task execution, supporting the 'no try/catch scaffolding' framing. However there is no evidence detailing configurable backoff strategies, per-step timeout settings, or failure policy configuration — missing for 10: documented backoff/timeout/failure-policy configuration options, code examples of retry policies, and independent corroboration of retry behavior in production.
